name: Eyeson
description_en:
Eyeson currently positions One View as programmable visual collaboration: audio, video and other feeds are combined into an interactive layout. Its API and SDKs make this an integration platform rather than simply a general-purpose employee meeting subscription.

The REST quickstart distinguishes API-key operations, participant access keys and guest tokens. Layout/layer behavior also depends on media mode. Those implementation conditions matter more than a generic list of video-chat labels.
description_zh:
Eyeson 当前将 One View 定位为可编程可视协作，把音频、视频及其他信息源组合到交互布局。API 和 SDK 使其成为集成平台，不只是通用员工会议订阅。

REST 入门区分 API 密钥操作、参与者访问密钥与访客令牌，布局/图层还受媒体模式影响。这些实施条件比通用视频聊天标签更重要。

core_features.explanation_en: Use API operations to position participants and add foreground/background layers.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过 API 放置参与者并添加前景/背景图层。

core_features.explanation_en: Room creation returns distinct host and guest joining links with different access.
core_features.explanation_zh: 创建房间返回访问不同的主持人及访客加入链接。

en: Create an account and API project, obtain a key, and create a room from a server-side request. The response includes a host GUI link and a guest link; the guide warns the host link is secret because it can start the meeting. Share the guest route with an ordinary participant instead of exposing management credentials.
zh: 注册账户及 API 项目后获取密钥，从服务端请求创建房间。响应包含主持人 GUI 链接与访客链接；指南提醒主持人链接可启动会议，必须保密。应向普通参与者分享访客路径，避免暴露管理凭据。

sections.title_en: Example: an expert discussion with a visual overlay
sections.title_zh: 示例：带信息叠层的专家讨论
sections.en:
Create an account and API project, obtain a key, and create a room from a server-side request. The response includes a host GUI link and a guest link; the guide warns the host link is secret because it can start the meeting. Share the guest route with an ordinary participant instead of exposing management credentials.

Add an overlay image or custom participant layout. MCU features require MCU mode, so a one-user test can force SFU disabled to expose them. A failed layout test in the wrong media mode does not establish that the layout API is broken. No request was executed here.
sections.zh:
注册账户及 API 项目后获取密钥，从服务端请求创建房间。响应包含主持人 GUI 链接与访客链接；指南提醒主持人链接可启动会议，必须保密。应向普通参与者分享访客路径，避免暴露管理凭据。

随后添加叠层图片或定制参与者布局。MCU 功能要求 MCU 模式，单用户测试可禁用 SFU 以显示这些能力。错误媒体模式下布局测试失败，不能直接认定布局 API 有问题。本文未实际请求。

sections.title_en: Sandbox and production need separate terms
sections.title_zh: 沙箱与生产需要不同条件
sections.en:
The pricing page offers a free sandbox key with all features, no card and a fair-use policy. The quickstart specifies 500 minutes for development and testing. These statements do not establish unlimited free production capacity. Paid rates are not public in the read offer; enterprise use is quoted with options for cloud provider, location, scaling and support.

Prepare expected participants, room duration, external sources, recording, deployment and support needs for the quote. No amount is normalized from a missing rate, and a cloud-location option is not proof that every deployment type is included by default.
sections.zh:
定价页提供含全部功能、无需卡、受公平使用限制的免费沙箱密钥；入门文档具体写明开发测试 500 分钟。这些不证明生产可无限免费。已读报价没有公开付费费率，企业使用需按云服务商、地区、扩缩容及支持选项询价。

应为报价准备参与人数、房间时长、外部源、录制、部署及支持需求。费率缺失时不归一金额，提供云地区选项也不证明所有部署类型默认包含。

sections.title_en: Diagnose the actual access or layout failure
sections.title_zh: 定位实际访问或布局失败
sections.en:
The quickstart recommends checking the Authorization header without a Bearer prefix, token validity, SFU/MCU mode and image dimensions. Oversized layer images can produce HTTP 400. These are concrete implementation failure modes, not measured resilience results.

Teams needing custom visual context can evaluate Eyeson; a host wanting only a ready meeting link may not need the API work. No SDK licence, self-hosting contract, latency, media recovery or recording completeness was verified. Vendor defense/public-safety examples do not certify suitability for an individual critical workflow.
sections.zh:
入门指南建议核对不带 Bearer 前缀的 Authorization、令牌有效性、SFU/MCU 模式及图片尺寸。图层图片过大可产生 HTTP 400。这些是具体实施失败原因，不是韧性实测结果。

需要定制可视背景的团队可评估 Eyeson，只需现成会议链接的主持人可能无需 API 工程。未核实 SDK 许可、自托管合同、延迟、媒体恢复或录制完整性。厂商国防/公共安全示例不能认证某个具体关键流程适用。
